subject: cline
title: Import-and-resume sessions from Claude Code, Codex, and opencode transcripts
one_why: Converted transcript keeps the source agent's tool names/schemas, so the first resumed turn folds the foreign history into a summary before any model request - the import-safe-resume policy is the copy-me part, not the parser.

subject: cline
title: Workspace-scoped .cline/Hooks subprocess hooks run with no trust gate
one_why: Opening a session in a cloned repo puts workspacePath/.cline/Hooks on the search path and those files spawn as subprocesses on lifecycle events; no trust identifier exists anywhere in hooks/ - the classic cloned-repo code-exec vector that crush's grant-scoping avoids.

subject: cline
title: Headless cron runs default to auto-approving every tool
one_why: Schedules without a mode resolve to yolo with {"*":{autoApprove:true}}, so unattended scheduled automation gets full write/exec access with no allowlist requirement - defensible for headless, dangerous as the default tier.

subject: cline
title: Compaction budget self-corrects from the provider's measured input-token count
one_why: When the previous request's actual tokens already exceed the estimator's count for the smaller transcript, the whole budget (trigger, target, projection) is scaled by that ratio, capped and never loosening - estimator drift can only cause early, never late, compaction.

subject: cline
title: Fail-closed tool approval: missing callback or callback exception both deny
one_why: A policy requiring approval with no configured approver, or an approver that throws, resolves to approved:false with a diagnostic reason - the deny-on-misconfiguration default many harnesses get backwards.

subject: cline
title: Full bench/eval framework exists but its CI workflow is switched off
one_why: cline-bench (12 production bug tasks) plus pass@k/pass^k analysis is exactly what the 8-to-10 verification gap needs, but it has been parked pending re-point at the new SDK CLI, so no agent-quality signal gates PRs.

subject: cline
title: Two independent runaway breakers: identical-call tracker plus consecutive-mistake tracker
one_why: Convergence with crush's loop breaker but split into soft-warning/hard-escalation on identical consecutive calls plus a separate per-session mistake counter - third harness now independently growing this organ; it should be table stakes.
